quest.title: Sightseeing With Friends: Underwater Fun
quest.description: Besides the iconic photo spot right outside the Court of Fontaine, Paimon seems to have an underwater tour planned as well...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ta-da! We're here! Let's go in from this shallow bit. It'll feel like we're walking into a painting — one that unfolds right before our very eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Marine
dialogues.text: Ah... It's you. And you've brought some new companions? Are they... Fungi? I've only ever read about them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a lovely surprise, a Melusine's hanging out here!

choices.text: Good to see you again, Marine.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: I'm not "hanging out," I'm picking Tidalga for this year's pickled batch. A lot of the others have returned to the village to help too.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Enghiene and little Roxane both took leave to come back and help. They're hard at work right now, and I'll be heading into the water myself in a bit.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: You know... Enghiene wasn't wrong. The blue Fungi really do look a bit like Tidalga...

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Not in a food sense! I just meant they're cute. Nothing else...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe~ You've got a good eye for cuteness!

choices.text: Our Fungi friends really are adorable.

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Anyway, really nice meeting you. I should get going — enjoy the rest of your time here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, shall we head out too? We're gonna get some amazing underwater shots in Fontaine with our Fungi friends!
